name: Callable Create
description: Publishes a callable in your namespace: a function others can call, which runs operation with your own authority narrowed by caps, whoever calls it, and names in your namespace. Holders of callable/call on it may call it; with a gate, so may anyone that gate operation admits. Pin an operation or gate to one definition by naming it a/<hash>. Needs callable/manage on x/callable/<name>.

name.description: The callable's name, unique in your namespace: [a-z0-9-]{1,64}

operation.description: The operation it runs, such as v/ops/covia/append, o/my-pipeline or a/<hash>. Bare paths are in your namespace.

caps.description: The capabilities bounding what it may do, within your authority: an array of {with, can} capabilities (UCAN.md §3), or "unrestricted" for all of your authority. Left out, it has none.

with.description: Resource path or prefix, such as w/guestbook

can.description: One ability, such as crud/write. To grant multiple abilities, use a separate capability entry for each.

gate.description: An operation deciding who else may call it, given {operation, input, caller, owner?} and run with the callable's authority; the call proceeds only if it succeeds. Standard gates: v/ops/callable/gates/anyone and v/ops/callable/gates/callers.

description.description: What it does, for its callers
